cases.about: A neighbor who’d known her for more than 50 years said she was an avid gardener who enjoyed feeding the squirrels. “We looked out for each other,” Lloyd Miller, said. “She took out my trash every week for me. She was a Christian & went to church every Sunday.” She had been walking at the school track for at least 40 years.
